closeout_basis: Lots 1, 2 and 3 jointly establish a bounded contact capability; no general contact or universal penalty claim is made.

penalty_policy.units: solver-native contact stiffness units; no universal nondimensional conversion is defined
penalty_policy.applicability: tested TET4 initial-search node-to-triangle penalty benchmark only
penalty_policy.rationale: The candidate values converged with non-increasing penetration over the declared Lot 1/2 sweeps, but mesh dependence, conditioning sensitivity and the absence of a universal physical scaling rule prevent production approval.

requirements.limitation: Signed gap and unilateral activation are bounded to the tested TET4 node-to-triangle route.
The common nonlinear driver is established for the exercised contact route only.
Residual and equilibrium observations are bounded to declared cases; no new universal release band is introduced.
Penalty sensitivity is characterized, but no production range or conditioning cutoff is approved.
Open/close/recontact is bounded to the fixed initial-search geometry.
Full only means the declared excessive-penetration contract and its tested route.
Determinism and finite diagnostics are established for the executed cases, not all future combinations.
Unsupported physics remains explicit and excluded from the claim.
Three controlled TET4 mesh levels and three candidate penalties; no universal mesh law.
Cycle evidence uses a fixed master surface and initial search.
State integrity is full for the exercised mutable/retry paths; stateless contact recomputation is recorded as N/A.
Failure behavior is full for the declared adversarial classes, not unregistered future inputs.
Candidate governance remains experimental and has no approved conditioning cutoff.
Code_Aster validates a scalar/active unilateral comparator, not a general deformable contact law.
Active branch agreement is strong; transition and gap-curve differences remain formulation- and mesh-dependent.
CalculiX is an elastic pre-contact C3D4 tie-breaker only.
The 1e4..1e6 interval is retained as an experimental candidate; Owner does not approve it for universal production use.
Aggregate traceability is closed for this bounded gate package; later contact capabilities require new evidence.

qualified_bounded_scope.benchmarks: declared Lot 1/2 TET4 cases and Lot 3 scalar/TET4 bounded external comparators
qualified_bounded_scope.claim: bounded unilateral contact behavior, load-path transitions, retry/rollback and fail-closed diagnostics for the tested TET4 route

external_evidence.mesh6_transition_warning: 5.25653195006103 percent, above the predeclared 5 percent warning limit; retained explicitly
external_evidence.interpretation: External evidence supports bounded unilateral normal kinematics and the tested TET4 path; it does not validate the QF penalty law identically.

explicit_exclusions: contact tangent qualification at active-set discontinuities
universal penalty range or conditioning cutoff
contact qualification beyond the tested TET4 route
limitations: Internal mesh sensitivity is bounded to three TET4 levels and shows observable dependence.
Code_Aster uses exact unilateral constraints rather than the QF penalty law; the mesh6 transition warning is above the predeclared warning limit.
CalculiX does not exercise contact detection, penalty enforcement or recontact.
No universal penalty scaling or conditioning threshold is approved.
The closeout does not promote friction, finite sliding, surface-to-surface contact or other element families.
